groups.prompt_section: Answer structure and Retention, rate, and entropy ranges

group_division: Each group divided equally across preparations. All scientific requirements are mandatory.
numeric_policy: Absolute endpoint error; candidate counts exact; allowed choices determined by true lower-net regret; arbitrary valid attaining witnesses accepted.
execution_policy: Artifact grading does not establish execution. Full isolated original and regenerated runs are required; infrastructure failures are BLOCKED.

dynamic_witness_checks.requirements: Both physical witnesses snap uniquely within witness_rates to locally compatible models; their common preparation satisfies bulk turnover within witness_turnover and selected net endpoint within witness_endpoint. Any attaining witness is accepted.

target_source: private/expected_answer.json, computed from exact simulation invariants; inference uses only task inputs
